insights.one_liner: JOE & THE JUICE is a Copenhagen-founded juice and coffee chain with over 500 shops; its Rotterdam service job needs no Dutch.

culture.text: Healthy fast-casual chain founded in Copenhagen in 2002, with more than 4,500 staff worldwide.
Promises a packed social calendar, an inclusive team and internal leadership and education programmes.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Has grown to more than 500 locations across 20 countries.
Entered its fourth new European market of 2026, opening in Madrid.
Is making a global breakfast push, with a new breakfast menu in 80 UK stores.

worth_knowing.text: Faced criticism in Dublin over replacing a popular local café.
